import sys

sys.path.insert(0, "tests")
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={
        "default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}
    },
    INSTALLED_APPS=["xor_lookups"],
)
django.setup()

from django.db import connection
from django.db.models import Q
from xor_lookups.models import Number

with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(Number)

Number.objects.bulk_create([Number(num=i) for i in range(10)])
pk = Number.objects.get(num=0).pk

print("SQL for 3-way XOR:")
print(
    Number.objects.filter(Q(pk=pk) ^ Q(pk=pk) ^ Q(pk=pk)).query
)

for n in range(1, 6):
    q = Q(pk=pk)
    for _ in range(n - 1):
        q = q ^ Q(pk=pk)
    print(f"{n} arg(s): count = {Number.objects.filter(q).count()}")

# parity spot-check with distinct conditions: exactly-one vs odd
# num__lte=7 (8 rows), num__gte=3 (7 rows), num__lte=1 (2 rows)
q3 = Q(num__lte=7) ^ Q(num__gte=3) ^ Q(num__lte=1)
print("3-way distinct XOR count:", Number.objects.filter(q3).count())
print("expected (parity):", len([i for i in range(10) if (i <= 7) ^ (i >= 3) ^ (i <= 1)]))
